narrative.headline: Choose Japan sightseeing dates with traceable weather and seasonal evidence.
narrative.value_prop: Resolve supported places, inspect bounded forecasts, and compare explicit criteria while keeping source time, forecast level and seasonal year visible.
narrative.auth_narrative: No credentials required for public HTML pages. Access is undocumented and subject to tenki.jp terms; this is a local tool, not a supported public API.

quickstart.command: tenki-pp-cli places search --query 千代田区 --limit 3
quickstart.comment: Resolve bounded candidates and keep ward identity.
Inspect source dates, units and freshness.
Evaluate explicit thresholds with source evidence.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for Japan outdoor sightseeing date and destination comparisons from tenki.jp. Inspect current seasonal conditions and forecast reference locations before recommending outings.
anti_triggers: Weather beyond the returned forecast horizon
